name: view-students-feature
description: Added View Students button to each schedule row in /admin/class-scheduling, which opens a modal showing all schedules for the section and all active students formatted as LASTNAME, FIRSTNAME, MIDDLE NAME sorted by last name.
content: Feature includes: state variables for modal, handleViewStudents function to fetch and format data, View Students button placed between Edit and Delete in each schedule row's Actions column, and a modal displaying section heading, schedule table, and student table with proper formatting and sorting.
